title: P15.9-B1: app shell + design tokens + parallel /app route tree
description: B1 of the approved P15.9-B0 master plan (PR #92, BASE b662914): new AppShell (sidebar groups Overview/Business/Operations/System per B.3, business switcher manual/last-used business_id contract B.5.3 — no /api/businesses enumeration, operator chip, theme toggle, breadcrumb topbar, mobile <768 bottom tab bar + More drawer, 768-1199 icon rail), semantic CSS tokens (tokens.css dark/light incl. --unknown for unverifiable), gloss map lib/gloss.ts (C.6), shared components (StatusBadge, ProofChip, EmptyState/ErrorState/DeniedState/UnverifiedPanel/Skeleton), /app/* parallel route tree with honest PlannedPage placeholders for all B2-B6 destinations. Old route tree untouched — / still serves the legacy Dashboard; no backend/auth/API/dependency change, no fake data, no redirects. Harness-executable proof: cockpit + met-fold vitest suites unchanged-green (zero backend diff). UI proof reported with PR: tsc PASS, vite build PASS, playwright e2e app.spec 12/12 + smoke 5/5 + chat 5/5 PASS against the real :8790 server.
